source: Previously uploaded /mnt/data/metrics_per_holdout(1).csv, center-aligned real-SSUSI heldout benchmark (12 selected, BRIGHT sectors over two development EDRs); computed means grouping by event and method.
purpose: Demonstrate why a time-selected primary benchmark with many EDR acquisitions is necessary. Not evidence of across-event significance.
selection_warning: All 12 sectors were selected using the observed flux signal by the previous strongest-window protocol. This is an active-feature stress test, not an unbiased time-and-coverage-only evaluation. The windows and pixels are correlated within two acquisition events. No p value or confidence interval is justified by n=12 sectors.
